bayts.text: and increase him in the most excellent peace, forever, on my behalf, O best Generous One worshipped.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have brought me to You through the accepted Intercessor, O You Who free from the envier and the cannon,
bless with a blessing that frees from Your enemies and Your prohibitions together, O Enricher,
with a peace that conveys righteousness to me, making gain and success everlasting for me,
upon him whose service turned the enemies toward others than me, all together, and they departed
toward other than my harm; and (turned away) corruption, guile, delusion and the enviers.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And grant me, today and after today, safety from what draws reproach.
And make, by the standing of the Chosen, my life a guarding of the Qurʾān with its verses
and the joy of every believer, Muslim and doer of good, protected from darknesses.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have granted me contemplation and direct vision; You have blessed me, benefited me with clarity.
Bless with a blessing that prevents my return to other than what pleases You, and (spares me) hunger,
for me, forever, with a peace that conveys certainty from You to me, O Conveyer,
upon him through whom I turned to You for years, and You led to me the lawful and the arts (of knowledge).
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And lead to me gratitude and new knowledge, and the reward of a benefit that drives off whoever deceived.
And raise my writings, O Appreciative, O best of those to Whom the grateful have turned.
I have begun to build an edifice of Remembrance: make my abiding for You the best gratitude.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have separated me from harm, You have joined me to piety.
You have awakened me with the awakening of an Appreciative, All-Knowing, Everlasting One, with Whom is benefit: You have led the sciences to me.
Bless with a blessing that prevents halting and sloth, O You Who have perpetuated honey for me,
with a peace that makes gain everlasting for me in all You bestow on me of the lawful,
upon him whose servant You have made me, and led to me his pre-eminence among creation.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And give me the fear of Allah, and make easy for me what You made hard for others than me, especially.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
Through You I have begun: so spare me obstacles, as I have willed, and spare me calamities.
And bless with peace, on my behalf, forever, him whose honouring has appeared to me,
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my undertaking drive the enemies toward a direction other than mine, disgracing the adversary.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have already come between me and the obstacle, You have joined me to what is fitting.
Bless with a blessing that bears witness to my undertaking, with a peace that bears witness to my going on,
upon him between whom and me there is union, without separation, O Confidant of whoever has arrived.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And reward on my behalf the people of Badr with good, O You Who through them drove harm toward others than me.
And grant me through them steadfast adherence to good things, making my passing and the abodes clear through them.
And make my writing above the supererogatory works, opening every lock for good.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have granted me, by Your grace, union; You have spared me, by Your keeping, separation.
bless with a blessing that repels obstacles toward a direction other than mine and leads to me what is fitting,
with a peace that repels corruptions toward other than my person and spares me the corrupt,
upon him whom my service gladdens, (I being) foremost among the servants.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
And make my recitation and my writing dearer to You than abundant good, O Beloved,
and in both lead the rewards to me from You, (You) just; and never shall I be unjust.
O Allah, O All-Merciful (Ar-Raḥmān), O Most Merciful (Ar-Raḥīm), O King (Al-Malik), O Holy (Al-Quddūs), O You Who honour me,
You have gathered for me what You chose, by (the Name) "the Gatherer" (Al-Jāmiʿ), and have been for me with the wish of the assemblies.
Bless with a blessing that bears witness for me to gratitude, with a peace that bears witness for me to praise
and my going on with truthfulness and fidelity, O You Who drove what terrifies toward others than me,
upon him through whom I reached You, and I neither hesitated nor separated.
our master Muḥammad, the Family and his Companions, in the present and in the final outcome.
